title: CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20828v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reasoning distillation requires chain-of-thought (CoT) data with correct answers, but obtaining such data efficiently remains challenging. Forward CoT generation (FCG) followed by rejection sampling (RS) produces verified, question-only responses, yet may require many teacher calls for difficult problems. Reverse CoT generation (RCG) is cheaper because it conditions on the known answer, but access to this answer can lead to post-hoc rationalization and a mismatch with the student's answer-free inference setting. We propose CoTranslator, which learns to translate reverse CoT responses toward the distribution of verified forward responses. Trained on a small set of paired reverse and rejection-sampled forward responses, it supports large-scale generation and verification of student training data. Across six student models evaluated on six mathematics benchmarks, CoTranslator improves average accuracy over semantic suppression by up to $5

translated_title: CoTranslator：面向推理蒸馏的从反向到正向思维链翻译器
translated_abstract: 推理蒸馏需要带有正确答案的思维链（CoT）数据，但如何高效获取此类数据仍具挑战性。正向CoT生成（FCG）结合拒绝采样（RS）可以产生经过验证的、仅基于问题的回答，但对于困难问题可能需要多次调用教师模型。反向CoT生成（RCG）成本更低，因为它以已知答案为条件，但能够访问答案会导致事后合理化，并与学生模型在无答案条件下的推理设置不匹配。我们提出CoTranslator，它学习将反向CoT回答转换（翻译）为经过验证的正向回答的分布。该方法仅需在一小组成对的反向回答与拒绝采样正向回答上训练，即可支持大规模的学生训练数据生成与验证。在六个学生模型和六个数学基准上的评估显示，与语义抑制方法相比，CoTranslator将平均准确率提升了最高5（原文此处被截断）
tldr: CoTranslator通过将反向思维链回答“翻译”为经过验证的正向回答分布，兼得低成本与高质量，实现大规模推理蒸馏数据生成，在六个数学基准上显著提升学生模型平均准确率最高5个百分点。
